unlisted_practices: Grounding LLM patient simulators in multi-source longitudinal patient profiles (demographics, standardized symptoms, counseling dialogues, life-event histories) to improve dialogue realism, behavioral diversity, and event richness
Chain-of-Change agent converting noisy longitudinal records into structured temporal memory for patient simulation

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an LLM agent framework (DEPROFILE) for simulating mental health patients from longitudinal evidence; it benchmarks model performance without testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
